thread:
sam: Quick sync — proposing a regional GPU resiliency scorecard + short runbook we can put in Grafana and link from the incident page. Goal: get a single per-region "health score" and a small set of alert rules for ECC/Xid/flaky-card symptoms so oncall can decide drain/replace within 15–60m.

sam: Scorecard idea (high level):
- Inputs: corrected ECC rate (per-card), uncorrected ECC events, Xid error rate, GPU eviction/restarts, kernel OOMs, device flakiness (card-level transient errors), successful jobs lost due to GPU errors.
- Combine into weighted score: healthy (>= 0.98), degraded (0.95-0.98), unhealthy (<0.95).
- Roll up per-region by averaging across active GPUs, exclude GPUs in maintenance/draining.

jia: +1. We should use rolling windows (5m for alerts, 1h for score) to avoid noisy flips. I can prototype PromQL for the panels.

jia: Example PromQL snippets for panels/alerts:
```promql
# per-card corrected ECC rate (per minute)
rate(nvidia_ecc_corrected_total{job="gpu-exporter"}[5m])

# Xid errors per card
increase(nvidia_xid_errors_total{job="gpu-exporter"}[5m])

# GPU pod evictions due to device plugin
increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{reason="OOMKilled",container=~".*gpu.*"}[5m])

# region healthy fraction: fraction of GPUs with score > 0.95 in last 1h
sum by(region) (gpu_card_health_score > 0.95) / sum by(region) (gpu_card_up == 1)
```

ryan_ops: Thinking about thresholds: Xid burst (>3 events in 5m) -> page oncall, sustained (>10 in 1h) -> consider drain. For corrected ECC we should avoid alerting unless uncorrected events appear or corrected rate is >> baseline (x10).

obrien: We need a clear definition of "flaky card": intermittent Xid/ECC + >1 pod eviction in last 24h OR multiple job failures. Also add a cooldown on automated drains: don't auto-drain unless metric persists for 30m and we've retried workload placement twice.

sre-bot: New dashboard created: "gpu-region-resiliency-v1" (link: https://grafana.internal/r/gpu-region-resiliency-v1) — panels: per-card telemetry, scorecard, top N noisy cards, region rollup.

sam: Nice. Can we include a small runbook snippet in the dashboard panel (copy of ops steps): quick triage -> decide drain -> run drain command -> track replacement ticket.

mia: I'll take dashboard implementation + panel notes. I'll add the runbook text under a "How to triage" panel.

mia: Suggested runbook text (short):
- Check panels: Xid spikes, ECC uncorrected, pod evictions, job failures.
- If Xid spike but no job failures: watch 30m, add annotations.
- If Xid spike + pod/job failures: begin safe drain of card.
- Drain steps:
```bash
# cordon and drain node with GPUs (preserve non-gpu workloads manually)
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
# mark node with label for hardware team
kubectl label node <node> gpu:needs-replace
```
- Create hardware ticket (include node, GPU UUID, exporter metrics snapshot, screenshots).

ryan_ops: For cost/rate conversation — replacement vs warranty: set a region-level threshold for replacements per week to catch vendor defects before we start paying OPEX balance. Also include a note: if replacements > 0.5% of fleet/week open escalation to infra leadership.

jia: Alerts I'd add now (P0/P1):
- P0: any uncorrected ECC >0 on a GPU -> immediate page + require manual ack.
- P1: Xid rate >3 in 5m on a single card and correlated job failures -> page oncall.
- P2: region health score < 0.95 for 1h -> slack alert + oncall notify but delayed 10m.

obrien: Automation notes: we should not auto-drain on first detection. Auto-notify and set an "auto-drain candidate" flag. If same card hits the criteria twice within 1h, then we can escalate to auto-schedule replacement (but still require human go-ahead for physical swap).

sam: Good call on safety. Also add an opt-in to suppress alerts during cluster maintenance windows (we already have maintenance tags; include in alert silence rule).

mia: I'll drop a PR for the dashboard JSON + alerts this afternoon. Can one of you review PromQL and the weightings? I propose weights: uncorrected ECC x4, Xid x3, evictions x2, corrected ECC x1, job failures x5.

sam: Reviewers: @jia + @ryan_ops. Let's aim to ship the dashboard and alert rules end of week. If folks agree, I'll update the incident runbook to link the dashboard and include the drain steps.

ryan_ops: acked. If we see >2 replacement candidates in a region in 48h, escalate to hardware & vendor.

jia: I'll review the queries and post suggested refinements by EOD.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window today 2026-03-20 22:00-23:30 UTC — alerts with tag maintenance will be silenced. :warning:

sam: Thanks all — great progress. Mia, ping when the PR is up and I'll validate weights and thresholds.
